alerts.headline: Freeze Warning issued October 15 at 9:26PM MDT until October 16 at 10:00AM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
alerts.description:
* WHAT...For the first Freeze Warning, sub-freezing temperatures as
low as 24 expected. For the second Freeze Warning, sub-freezing
temperatures as low as 27 expected.

* WHERE...Central Yampa River Basin, Lower Yampa River Basin, Upper
Yampa River Basin, San Juan River Basin, and Central Colorado River
Basin.

* WHEN...For the first Freeze Warning, until 10 AM MDT Friday. For
the second Freeze Warning, from midnight Friday Night to 10 AM MDT
Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other
sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor
plumbing.

afd.snippet: 000 FXUS65 KBOU 160708 AFDBOU Area Forecast Discussion National Weather Service Denver/Boulder CO 108 AM MDT Fri Oct 16 2026 .KEY MESSAGES... - First freeze of the season expected over most of the plains tonight. - Chilly but dry/sunny weather Friday, with another freeze north and east of the Denver metro area Friday night. - Mainly dry and warmer for the weekend through the middle of next week. -

alerts.title: Paving Operations-149375
alerts.description: Between Exit 140: US 6; Gypsum and US 6 (near Eagle) from Mile Point 146.25 to Mile Point 147.6. Right shoulder closed due to paving operations. Starting October 15, 2026 at 9:00PM MDT until October 16, 2026 at about 5:00AM MDT. Full schedule below: • October 15, 9:00PM - October 16, 5:00AM Comment: Eastbound and westbound staggered I-70 Eagle (Exit 147) on/off ramp closures. Eastbound off-ramp: Use Gypsum (Exit 140) and US 6 east to Eagle. Eastbound on-ramp: Use US 6 east to Wolcott (Exit 157) to access I-70 eastbound. Westbound off-ramp: Use Wolcott (Exit 157) and US 6 west to Eagle. Westbound on-ramp: Use US 6 west to Gypsum (Exit 140) to access I-70 westbound.

alerts.title: I-70 Glenwood Canyon Bridge Joint Improvements-148510
alerts.description: Between Exit 125: Hanging Lake and Exit 129: Bair Ranch (4 to 5 miles west of the Dotsero area) from Mile Point 127 to Mile Point 128. Right lane closed due to bridge construction. Starting tomorrow at 7:00AM MDT until tomorrow at about 7:01PM MDT. Full schedule below: • October 16, 7:00AM - October 16, 7:01PM Comment: Eastbound and westbound lane width restrictions, for commercial and recreational vehicles, are in effect 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. A commercial and recreational vehicle width limit of 11'-0" is in place for the duration of the project. Eastbound I-70 will be reduced to one lane from Mile Point 127 to 128. Westbound from Mile Point 125 to 126 on the east side of Hanging Lake Tunnel will be one-lane for bridge joint water testing. Daytime work hours will be 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., Monday through Friday. The speed limit will be reduced to 35 mph through the work zone.

alerts.title: US 40 Milner Resurfacing-147529
alerts.description: Between Down Hill Drive (near Steamboat Springs) and County Road 29 (5 miles west of the Hayden area) from Mile Point 128.8 to Mile Point 100.5. Road construction. Starting October 16, 2026 at 8:30AM MDT until October 16, 2026 at about 7:00PM MDT. Full schedule below: • October 16, 8:30AM - October 16, 7:00PM Comment: Alternating one-lane traffic as the project completes shouldering , rumble strips and final striping. Ten to 15 minute delays should be expected. The project is 14-miles of resurfacing along US Highway 40 through Milner. Paving work will take place from the Xcel Energy Hayden station, Mile Point 112, to about five miles west of Steamboat Springs, MP 126.Additional work includes guardrail replacement, minor improvements and safety enhancements on three bridges and slope stabilization. The project is expected to be completed by the middle of November.
